verdict.rationale: Runpod's public pricing page lists per-GPU-hour prices, for example the B300 at $8.99/hr, with Community Cloud and Secure Cloud per-hour and per-second options. Sales contact is only required for reserved or contract pricing, so on-demand rates are self-serve. Missing for 10: evidence that every GPU type is listed (only one GPU row appears in the pack), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the full price table.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales

citations.quote: B300 288 GB HBM3e 251 GB RAM 32 vCPUs $8.99/hr
